scope: Unpowered one-drive fit and assembly article
printer_basis: User-confirmed PETG, 0.4 mm nozzle on X2D
readiness: Structural and assembly corrections needed before a complete test article; fit coupons can precede it

confirmed_findings.finding: Shell body 32 is five native solids
confirmed_findings.detail: Two bridge blocks are 5 mm from the main solid; two input-bearing bosses touch it without being fused. Refined shell STL is non-watertight.
confirmed_findings.needed: Connect the supports with real load-carrying webs and positive overlap, fuse intentional connections, and verify one watertight structural part.

confirmed_findings.finding: Both wheel outer-bearing bosses are disconnected
confirmed_findings.detail: Wheel bodies 13 and 30 each contain two native solids with a 1 mm gap.
confirmed_findings.needed: Connect each bearing boss to the wheel sidewall and verify a single solid.

confirmed_findings.finding: New and old outer-bearing references overlap
confirmed_findings.detail: Each new Y151-158 bearing overlaps the original Y146-153 reference by 2 mm; exact overlap is 659.734 mm3 per side.
confirmed_findings.needed: Select one bearing station and correct bearing references, shaft engagement, spacers, shoulders, and retention together.

confirmed_findings.finding: Center support and servo cradle have no complete shell attachment
confirmed_findings.detail: Center support body 356 is separate despite 1808.977 mm3 overlap with the shell. Servo cradle body 300 has face contact with the shell but zero volumetric overlap.
confirmed_findings.needed: Define intentional fusion or accessible positive fasteners for each separate part.

confirmed_findings.finding: Right inboard spacer is not mirrored to the updated left station
confirmed_findings.detail: Left spacer body 224 is at Y95-98; right spacer body 227 remains at Y-47.5 to -44.5.
confirmed_findings.needed: Correct the right stack before a two-drive article.

confirmed_findings.finding: Shaft coupling and retention remain incomplete
confirmed_findings.detail: Coupler and input-pulley clamp slits are modeled; complete clamp actuation, measured servo interface, input axial retention, and clutch preload/torque-transfer details remain unresolved.
confirmed_findings.needed: Use real fastening interfaces and verify assembly and belt-tension access. Clutch torque calibration can follow the unpowered fit stage.

positive_checks: Left input pulley to shell minimum nominal clearance: 2.25 mm
Left output pulley to shell minimum nominal clearance: 2.462688 mm
Left wheel to shell minimum nominal clearance: 5 mm
Both pulley prototypes are valid single native solids and have watertight scene meshes
next_print_sequence: Print PETG bearing-seat and shaft-bore coupons in the intended production orientation; measure fits with the actual bearings and shafts
Correct the structural connections, left bearing station, and hardware interfaces
Export and slice a left-drive shell section and its printed drive parts from the corrected master
Inspect first layers, bearing-seat toolpaths, bridges, supports and removal access before printing
Assemble by hand and record alignment, rotation, endplay, belt tracking, installation and service access
limitations: Renders use a review color palette and hide the upper shell or wheels in labeled cutaway views
Nominal static CAD checks do not establish PETG strength or received-part fit
Current review STL files are evidence exports, not released print files
No current corrected-article slice or physical test has been performed
Electronics integration and powered testing are outside this fit-article stage
